Earlier scenes:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。搬家对孟子有好的影响，他才五岁，可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈的工作。

This scene:
他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人：很聪明

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他很聪明的人：他是一个很聪明的人，A noun phrase used as the predicate needs the copula 是; 一个 also supplies the appropriate classifier phrase before 人. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 成为：成为了，This is a completed change of status in the narrative, so becoming a well-known person takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他：∅，Within the same sentence, the subject has already been established, so the later pronoun should be omitted and understood as a zero form. [rule: redundancy_delete]

items.reason: “他很聪明的人” lacks the needed predicate structure, and “他是一个很聪明的人” is grammatical.
The becoming event is completed in this past narrative, so “成为了” correctly marks completion, but the earlier predicate error remains.
The second “他” begins a new clause and is an acceptable close reference; zero reference is not required here.
